material_description: Ac-ZTC1 | KOH-activated ZTC1 (ZTC/KOH 1:4 by weight, 800 C, 1 h, N2 flow)
purification_method: 10% HF washes (several), then reflux in concentrated HCl at 60 C (zeolite template removal); after activation washed several times with 2 M HCl, then distilled water to neutral pH; dried at 120 C for 3 h
activation_method: KOH activation, ZTC/KOH 1:4 by weight, ground in agate mortar, heated at 3 C/min to 800 C under N2 and held 1 h
source_location: main.pdf p.4 (printed p.11317), Figure 3 panel f, series f (Ac-ZTC1, open red circles), marker 3 of 26 separated
notes: archive: HYC-0103_fig3f_AcZTC1.json; T printed as -196 C (77.15 K); BET range: 0.06-0.22; degassing printed as 'evacuated up to 10-7 bar under heating at 120 C overnight' (10-7 bar = 0.01 Pa; duration not numeric); H2 99.9999% additionally purified by molecular sieve filter; buoyancy correction used carbon density 1.5 g/cm3 (stored in skeletal_density_g_cm3) and hydrogen density 0.04 g/cm3, both assumed values; paper does not name the uptake basis (coded excess from the stated buoyancy correction of a gravimetric value); micropore area and volume by t-plot, total pore volume from N2 uptake at P/P0 ~0.99; DFT pore size maxima 1.3/2.3 nm; isotherm_point_count is the number of markers separated on the page image; markers below about 2 bar overlap and could not be counted, so it is a lower bound. Paper: isotherms completely reversible with no hysteresis (Section 3); branches not distinguishable in Figure 3, coded adsorption

material_description: Ac-ZTC3 | KOH-activated ZTC3 (ZTC/KOH 1:4 by weight, 800 C, 1 h, N2 flow)
purification_method: 10% HF washes (several), then reflux in concentrated HCl at 60 C (zeolite template removal); after activation washed several times with 2 M HCl, then distilled water to neutral pH; dried at 120 C for 3 h
activation_method: KOH activation, ZTC/KOH 1:4 by weight, ground in agate mortar, heated at 3 C/min to 800 C under N2 and held 1 h
source_location: main.pdf p.4 (printed p.11317), Figure 3 panel d, series d (Ac-ZTC3, open green down-triangles), marker 4 of 25 separated
notes: archive: HYC-0103_fig3d_AcZTC3.json; T printed as -196 C (77.15 K); BET range: 0.06-0.22; degassing printed as 'evacuated up to 10-7 bar under heating at 120 C overnight' (10-7 bar = 0.01 Pa; duration not numeric); H2 99.9999% additionally purified by molecular sieve filter; buoyancy correction used carbon density 1.5 g/cm3 (stored in skeletal_density_g_cm3) and hydrogen density 0.04 g/cm3, both assumed values; paper does not name the uptake basis (coded excess from the stated buoyancy correction of a gravimetric value); micropore area and volume by t-plot, total pore volume from N2 uptake at P/P0 ~0.99; DFT pore size maxima 1.3/3.4 nm; isotherm_point_count is the number of markers separated on the page image; markers below about 2 bar overlap and could not be counted, so it is a lower bound. Paper: isotherms completely reversible with no hysteresis (Section 3); branches not distinguishable in Figure 3, coded adsorption

material_description: Ac-ZTC3 | KOH-activated ZTC3 (ZTC/KOH 1:4 by weight, 800 C, 1 h, N2 flow)
purification_method: 10% HF washes (several), then reflux in concentrated HCl at 60 C (zeolite template removal); after activation washed several times with 2 M HCl, then distilled water to neutral pH; dried at 120 C for 3 h
activation_method: KOH activation, ZTC/KOH 1:4 by weight, ground in agate mortar, heated at 3 C/min to 800 C under N2 and held 1 h
source_location: main.pdf p.4 (printed p.11317), Figure 3 panel d, series d (Ac-ZTC3, open green down-triangles), marker 21 of 25 separated
notes: archive: HYC-0103_fig3d_AcZTC3.json; T printed as -196 C (77.15 K); BET range: 0.06-0.22; degassing printed as 'evacuated up to 10-7 bar under heating at 120 C overnight' (10-7 bar = 0.01 Pa; duration not numeric); H2 99.9999% additionally purified by molecular sieve filter; buoyancy correction used carbon density 1.5 g/cm3 (stored in skeletal_density_g_cm3) and hydrogen density 0.04 g/cm3, both assumed values; paper does not name the uptake basis (coded excess from the stated buoyancy correction of a gravimetric value); micropore area and volume by t-plot, total pore volume from N2 uptake at P/P0 ~0.99; DFT pore size maxima 1.3/3.4 nm; isotherm_point_count is the number of markers separated on the page image; markers below about 2 bar overlap and could not be counted, so it is a lower bound. Paper: isotherms completely reversible with no hysteresis (Section 3); branches not distinguishable in Figure 3, coded adsorption
